name: outseta
label: Outseta
description: Triggers and actions for Outseta CRM and Billing

domain.label: Outseta Domain
domain.description: Your full Outseta domain URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.outseta.com. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Found in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API

apiSecret.label: API Secret
apiSecret.description: Found alongside your API Key in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API

get_person.label: Retrieve Person
get_person.description: Retrieve a person by email or by UID, including the linked account.

lookupBy.label: Lookup by
lookupBy.description: How to find the person to retrieve.

email.label: Email
email.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Email.

personUid.label: Person UID
personUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Person UID.

get_deal.label: Retrieve Deal
get_deal.description: Retrieve a deal by its UID, or by the email of the contact associated with the deal plus the pipeline.

lookupBy.label: Lookup by
lookupBy.description: How to find the deal to retrieve.

dealUid.label: Deal UID
dealUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Deal UID.

contactEmail.label: Contact Email
contactEmail.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Contact email + pipeline.

pipelineUid.label: Pipeline
pipelineUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Contact email + pipeline. Required in that mode.

create_account.label: Create Account
create_account.description: Create a new account in Outseta CRM. Optionally start a subscription on a plan in the same call.

clientIdentifier.label: Client Identifier
clientIdentifier.description: A custom identifier you assign to this account (e.g. your internal customer ID).

invoiceNotes.label: Invoice Notes
invoiceNotes.description: Notes that appear on invoices sent to this account.

primaryContactPersonUid.label: Primary Contact Person UID
primaryContactPersonUid.description: Optional. UID of an existing person to set as primary contact on the new account. Required by Outseta when starting a subscription with a paid plan.

planUid.label: Starting Plan
planUid.description: Optional. If set, the account is created with an active subscription on this plan.

billingRenewalTerm.label: Billing Renewal Term
billingRenewalTerm.description: Used only when Starting Plan is set. Defaults to Monthly.

create_deal.label: Create Deal
create_deal.description: Create a new deal in the CRM.

contactEmail.label: Contact Email
contactEmail.description: Email of the person to associate with this deal.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: UID of the account to associate with this deal.

list_accounts.label: List Accounts
list_accounts.description: Retrieve a paginated list of accounts from your Outseta CRM.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_persons.label: List Persons
list_persons.description: Retrieve a paginated list of persons from your Outseta CRM.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of persons to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_deals.label: List Deals
list_deals.description: Retrieve a paginated list of deals from your Outseta CRM.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_plans.label: List Plans
list_plans.description: Retrieve a paginated list of subscription plans from your Outseta billing catalog.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of plans to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_addons.label: List Add-Ons
list_addons.description: Retrieve a paginated list of add-ons from your Outseta billing catalog.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of add-ons to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_discounts.label: List Discounts
list_discounts.description: Retrieve a paginated list of discount coupons from your Outseta billing catalog.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of discounts to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

list_cases.label: List Cases
list_cases.description: Retrieve a paginated list of support tickets (cases) from Outseta. Optionally filter by the person who submitted them.

fromPersonUid.label: From Person UID
fromPersonUid.description: Optional. Only return cases submitted by this person.

fromPersonEmail.label: From Person Email
fromPersonEmail.description: Optional. Only return cases submitted by the person with this email.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of cases to return (default 100).

offset.label: Page
offset.description: Page number to fetch (0 = first page, 1 = second page, ...). Outseta uses page-based pagination, not record-based.

change_account_plan.label: Change Account Plan
change_account_plan.description: Change an account's current subscription plan (upgrade, downgrade, or switch to free).

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account whose plan to change.

add_discount_to_subscription.label: Apply Discount to Account
add_discount_to_subscription.description: Apply a discount coupon to the current subscription of an account.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account whose subscription will receive the discount.

discountUid.label: Discount
discountUid.description: Select the discount coupon to apply.

add_addon_usage.label: Add Usage for Add-on
add_addon_usage.description: Track usage for a metered (usage-based) add-on on an account.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account to record usage for.

usageDate.label: Usage Date
usageDate.description: The date of usage. Defaults to now if not provided.

add_addon_to_subscription.label: Add Add-on to Subscription
add_addon_to_subscription.description: Attach a recurring add-on to an account's current subscription. Different from Add Usage for Add-on, which only records consumption on a metered add-on already attached.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account whose subscription will receive the add-on.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of add-on units to attach. Defaults to 1.

billingRenewalTerm.label: Billing Renewal Term
billingRenewalTerm.description: How often the add-on is billed. Defaults to Monthly.

update_payment_information.label: Update Payment Information
update_payment_information.description: Update the credit card / payment method on an account. The payment processor tokens (CustomerToken, PaymentToken) must come from your payment processor (e.g. Stripe Elements) — not from Outseta.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account to update payment information for.

customerToken.label: Customer Token
customerToken.description: The customer ID issued by the payment processor (e.g. Stripe customer ID, "cust_…").

paymentToken.label: Payment Token
paymentToken.description: The payment method ID issued by the payment processor (e.g. Stripe payment method, "pm_…").

nameOnCard.label: Name on Card
nameOnCard.description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card.

add_invoice.label: Create Invoice
add_invoice.description: Create an ad-hoc invoice for an account. The invoice is linked to the account's current subscription.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account to invoice.

description.label: Description
description.description: Description for the invoice line item.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount for the invoice line item.

add_invoice_payment.label: Add Invoice Payment
add_invoice_payment.description: Record a payment against an invoice. The invoice is marked as paid if the total payments match the invoice amount.

accountUid.label: Account UID
accountUid.description: The UID of the account that owns the invoice.

invoiceUid.label: Invoice UID
invoiceUid.description: The UID of the invoice to apply the payment to.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Payment amount as a negative number (e.g. -49.00), as required by the Outseta API.

update_account_membership.label: Update Account Membership
update_account_membership.description: Update a person's membership on an account — typically used to designate them as the primary contact.

personUid.label: Person UID
personUid.description: The UID of the person whose membership to update.

isPrimary.label: Is Primary Contact
isPrimary.description: Whether this person should be the primary contact for the account.

add_reply.label: Reply to Ticket
add_reply.description: Add a reply to an existing support ticket (case) in Outseta.

caseUid.label: Case UID
caseUid.description: The UID of the support ticket to reply to.

agentName.label: Agent Name
agentName.description: Name of the agent sending the reply.
